policies.reference_values: Always retain application + operating-condition + source context. Do not collapse conflicting values globally.
policies.provenance: Every normalized record should carry source key/page/section where available. Numeric SQLite IDs are importer-generated, not stored in JSON.

known_limitations: 4JZ1 training manual is not a complete workshop-manual DTC catalog; only DTCs explicitly present in that source are enriched.
Some scanned excerpt PDFs have no text layer; their canonical parent manuals were used for normalized extraction and excerpts are retained for cross-validation.
Some DTC titles differ across generations; alternate titles are preserved rather than force-normalized.
OEM full diagnostic procedures are available for 92 DTCs in the 4HK1 TM source; other profiles may only have title/conditions/causes depending on source coverage.
